video.title: Custom View, ViewBuilder & GeometryReader | Day 150
video.description:
Learn to explain how to build reusable SwiftUI views: Custom View, ViewBuilder & GeometryReader, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Custom View - A struct of your own that conforms to View, so you can reuse it like a built-in view.
ViewBuilder - An attribute that lets a closure return several views without a return keyword.
GeometryReader - A container that gives its content the size of the space it has.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain Custom View, ViewBuilder & GeometryReader in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.

Custom View - A struct of your own that conforms to View, so you can reuse it like a built-in view.
한국어: 커스텀 뷰: View를 따르는 직접 만든 구조체로, 기본 뷰처럼 재사용할 수 있어요

ViewBuilder - An attribute that lets a closure return several views without a return keyword.
한국어: 뷰빌더: 클로저가 return 없이 여러 뷰를 돌려줄 수 있게 하는 어트리뷰트

GeometryReader - A container that gives its content the size of the space it has.
한국어: 지오메트리리더: 자신이 가진 공간의 크기를 내용물에게 알려 주는 컨테이너

landscape.hook: Can you explain Custom View, ViewBuilder and GeometryReader in English?

dialogue.title: Reuse the header

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my profile header code is long, and I use it on three screens.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Make it a Custom View. It is your own struct that conforms to View.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Every Custom View can be reused like a built-in view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Inside the body I return two views, and Swift does not complain. Why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Because of ViewBuilder. It lets a closure return several views without `return`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In `body` and in the closures of stacks, yes. In your own functions, you add it yourself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I want the second view to know its available size.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a GeometryReader. It gives its content the size of the space it has.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used a GeometryReader around everything, and my layout became strange.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It takes all the space it can get. Use GeometryReader only where you really need the size.
Move the header into a Custom View.
